digest.component_or_area: rebar._store git call sites (gitutil, lock, event_append, commands/compact/delete/fsck, metrics)
propositions: High local concurrency among many rebar agent processes causes contention on shared .git/index.lock and ref locks (HEAD.lock, packed-refs.lock), surfacing errors to callers instead of being absorbed.
Local git call sites have no unified contention policy and several have no bounds at all, leaving agents unbounded on hung mounts or stuck locks while holding the store write lock.

Transient git lock conflicts must resolve silently with bounded jittered retry-backoff (order of tens of seconds), and only permanently stuck locks should surface one actionable error naming the lock file and holder guidance.

An advisory per-store flock plus jittered retry on git's own lock signatures, combined with watchdog timeouts on local-only call sites and jittered sleeps on store-lock contention, automatically absorbs lock contention with no escalation to agents.
